var_desc: best_fvc - best forced vital capacity from best curve (best curve is an acceptable curve that has max [fvc + fev1 ] ): measured in liters
scnd_fvc - best forced vital capacity from 2nd best curve (second best curve is second highest [fvc + fev1 ] ): measured in liters
thrd_fvc - best forced vital capacity from 3rd best curve (third best curve is third highest [ fvc + fev1 ] ): measured in liters
